texts.zh: 从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
texts.en: The readings from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although we cannot be sure, our [Owner.GetLinguists] are convinced that it is a form of poetry. They propose we answer in kind.

label.en: Of course. Send back a battle chant!

tooltips.zh:

旌旗拥、百万貔貅。

Hark! Let the banners fly -
For now to war we ride

我们可以分享一些关于求索的诗句。
label.en: We can share some fine poetry about discovery.

tooltips.zh: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
tooltips.en: To strive, to seek, to find... and not to yield.

label.zh: 用一些象征友谊的诗句打动他们。
label.en: Bedazzle them with poetry about friendship.

tooltips.zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。
tooltips.en: Shall I compare thee to a solar wind...

label.zh: 给他们整点稀奇古怪的。

石室诗士施氏嗜狮，
施氏时时适市视狮。
tooltips.en:
Jolifanto bambla o falli bambla
grossiga m'pfa habla horem

label.en: We don't have time for this.

notes.en: Review note: five options — A battle chant (non-pacifist owner), B discovery poem, C friendship poem (non-xenophobe owner), D something enigmatic, E “no time” (goes straight to the generic proactive end stage, line 6851).

texts.zh: 在我们播报了战歌数个小时后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯中断了。他们把舰船远远地开到了有效攻击距离以外。可以认为他们应该是理解了我们信息的主旨，并且对此可一点都不感到高兴。
texts.en: Several hours after we broadcast the battle chant, transmissions from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] ceased. Their ship has positioned itself well out of effective attack range. We can surmise that they understood the gist of our message, and were not gladdened by what they heard.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个外星势力的代称。
note.en: In the game, the working name of this alien power appears here.

notes.zh: 审阅注：455 与 472 的选项都把阶段设为通用谨慎收尾阶段（100/103/104），不属于本链专属结局。
notes.en: Review note: 455 and 472 both set the generic cautious end stage (100/103/104); they are chain endings without a dedicated closing event.

texts.zh: 就在我们发出信息的数分钟后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信息发生了变化。内容依旧抑扬顿挫，但不再是和风细雨，而如同激起了惊涛骇浪。听起来像是一首战争的颂歌。他们并没有做出什么敌对的行为，而只是被我们的战歌所打动了而已。我们又发送了起初那首诗的几个不同版本，并且也快速地在整理[This.ContactCountry.GetName]战歌的大纲。
texts.en: Within minutes of our transmission, the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] changed. Still rhythmically flawless, they were no longer soothing, but rather upbeat, exciting. Much like a battle chant in fact. No hostile movements were made - they seem contented rather than provoked by our poetry. We have since sent several variations of the first chant, and in return are rapidly collecting a compendium of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] war poetry.

label.zh: 和这个物种真是相见恨晚。
label.en: A species after our own hearts.

label.zh: 进入阶段：诗歌收尾阶段(难度3)

texts.zh: 我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]向我们发送来的信息了。基于他们的构句方法得知，他们对诗词艺术有着难以想象的执着。这种儒雅风流的沟通方式不仅使我们获得了他们的尊重，同时也让我们充分地了解了他们。
texts.en: Our efforts have paid off, allowing us to interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. Based on their compositional style, they place an incredible importance in the poetic arts. By participating in this lyrical exchange, we have not only earned their admiration, but also learned a considerable amount about them during the process.

note.en: Admirer-of-poetry opinion and 10 intel.

texts.zh: 好像[This.ContactCountry.GetName]听完我们的战歌以后生气了。他们的几乎瞬间回以暴力。他们的武器开始开火，我们的舰船很幸运地全身而退。看来一场大战是不可避免了。
texts.en: It appears the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] took offense to our battle chant. Their response was instantaneous - and violent. They began firing, and our vessel was fortunate to escape unharmed. It seems we have a fight on our hands!

tooltips.en: The [contact_country.GetName] are now hostile to us.

texts.zh: 随着我们互相理解的加深，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]或者说[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]对我们的敌意缓和了。尽管仍有侵略性，他们好像把我们视为了乐意进一步交流的“可敬的战士”。至于这会是一段友谊的开端或者是战争的序曲我们仍不得而知，但至少我们已经重温了一遍先祖流传的战争之音！
texts.en: As we come to understand each other, hostilities with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - or rather, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - have ceased. Despite their aggression, they appear to consider us "honorable warriors" who they would gladly spar with again. Whether this is the beginning of friendship or a prelude to war remains to be seen, but at least we've been able to brush up on our war chants!

note.en: Unity reward (more if militarist) and a poetic-warrior opinion from the contact.

texts.zh: 对方对我们诗歌热忱回应：他们发来了一串不间断的长时间通讯，我们可以迅速地构建[This.ContactCountry.GetName]行文字典。尽管我们还未能辨识这些单词的含义，但这些外星人好像对对应我们诗歌中的平仄清浊得心应手，这也便于我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]理解他们。
texts.en: The response to our poem appears to have been enthusiastic: the stream of broadcasts continues unabated, and we are developing a considerable library of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] compositions. Although we have yet to put meanings to the words, these aliens have proven remarkably adept at matching the pitch and tone of our poems, something which is sure to help our [Owner.GetLinguists] interpret them.

texts.zh: 在几分钟的沉默后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯恢复了。尽管还不能理解，但他们的态度发生了明显的转变：我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]称听到了俏皮而扭捏的旋律。虽然有点难以置信，似乎他们在与我们调情。
texts.en: After several long minutes of silence, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions resumed. Although still incomprehensible, they were markedly different: a melody described by our [Owner.GetLinguists] as playful, almost bashful. Startlingly, it appears that they are flirting with us!

进入阶段：诗歌：花言巧语收尾阶段(难度3)

texts.zh:
我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]向我们发送来的信息了：

“啊，巧夺天工的谄媚。遇到另一个珍视诗歌的物种已是三生有幸，谁曾想到，亲爱的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]，你们竟是如此热情洋溢、乖唇蜜舌。祝福你们的[Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]。”

信息后面还有许多诸如此类的词句。我们也没法完全确定是该受宠若惊还是直接大吃一惊，但也许我们的关系是有了个不错的开端。
texts.en:
Our efforts have paid off, and we can now interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]:

"Ah, the fine art of flattery. It is nice indeed to meet another species that appreciates poetry, and especially one as exuberant and adorable as you, my sweet [Owner.GetSpeciesName] - bless your [Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]."

The message continues at some length in a similar vein. We are not entirely sure whether to be flattered or taken aback, but it seems our relationship is off to a good start.

note.en: Poetic-flatterer opinion from the contact.

texts.zh: 焦急等待的过程分秒如年，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]依旧没有回应。尽管他们不太可能理解我们诗歌的具体含义，但他们好像对里面的情感表达吓住了，开始转用一种更谨慎的态度与我们接触。
texts.en: Minutes turned into hours, and still there was no response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Though they couldn't possibly have understood the exact meaning of our poetry, it seems they were taken aback by the emotions expressed in it, and are now approaching us in a far more guarded manner.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个外星势力的代称。

texts.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]以相似的方式回应了：抑扬顿挫的诗歌变成了随机的噪音，模仿着我们的嗓音。很遗憾，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]表示，对这些声音的解码“完全没有用”，因为现在的这些信号根本没有任何规律可言。
texts.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are responding in kind: rhythmical chants have turned to random noise, mimicking our own incoherent sounds. Despairingly, our [Owner.GetLinguists] describe our efforts to decode these sounds as "completely useless", owing to the fact that it is now impossible to detect any sort of pattern.

texts.zh: 在冗长而困难的第一次接触流程后，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]终于认出[This.ContactCountry.GetName]应该被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。他们祝贺我们解开了他们的字谜，但看起来对我们花费如此长的时间颇有不满。最后的最后，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]得以研发出数种新的模式辨识方法，让我们在未来可以更容易破译语言。
texts.en: After a long and arduous first contact process, our [Owner.GetLinguists] can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. They congratulate us for solving their linguistic riddles, although they seem a little put out with us that it took this long. At the very least, our [Owner.GetLinguists] were able to pioneer several new methods of pattern recognition which should stand us in good stead in the future.

summary.text:
# 诗歌 / Poetry
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（首个事件「诗歌」first_contact.450）
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_events.txt:6738–7170, 8017–8030` · `common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:678–704, 2169–2243`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

第二阶段抽取，权重 2；本方有此链标记或为格式塔、对方为格式塔则为 0，且对方必须采用“主动”首次接触政策，否则为 0（`common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:679–704`）。/ Stage-2 weight 2; zero if the owner already had the chain or is gestalt, if the contact is gestalt, or if the contact is not on the proactive first-contact policy.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**诗歌（450）**：对方信号富有节奏、令人平静。五个选择：/ Five choices:
- A 战歌（非和平主义者）→ 隐藏随机三选一：455 对方不悦（→通用谨慎收尾）；460 对方回以战歌（→诗歌收尾阶段→480）；462 战歌反噬开火，并进入敌对收尾阶段（→475）。/ Battle chant → hidden random: offence (455), war chant exchange (460 → 480) or backfire (462 → 475).
- B 探索诗歌 → 465 交换诗歌 → 诗歌收尾阶段 → **480**。/ Discovery poem → 465 → 480.
- C 友谊诗（非排外者）→ 对方亲异族则 470 调戏 → 花言巧语收尾阶段 → **490**；否则 472 无回应（通用谨慎收尾）。/ Friendship poem → 470 → 490 if the contact is xenophile, else 472.
- D 晦涩之物 → 474 随机噪音 → 达达收尾阶段 → **485**。/ Something enigmatic → 474 → 485.
- E 没时间 → 直接进入通用主动收尾阶段。/ No time → generic proactive end stage.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

475 / 480 / 485 / 490 为四种专属结局；455、472、E 落入通用收尾。/ Four dedicated endings (475, 480, 485, 490); 455, 472 and option E fall into the generic end.
所有收尾选项都调用 finish_first_contact_effect（建立正式通讯，之后按帝国类型转入后续事件，如反向接触、教程、商队等），并调用 first_contact_inform_intel。 / Every ending option calls finish_first_contact_effect (opens regular communications, then routes to follow-ups such as reverse first contact, tutorial, caravaneer events) and first_contact_inform_intel.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

选项 A 要求本方非和平主义；C 要求非排外。/ Option A needs a non-pacifist owner; C needs a non-xenophobe.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：450–490、462 脚本及五个诗歌阶段、第二阶段条目。
- 审阅改动 Changes：原 event-first-contact-475/480/485/490 四篇单页合并入本篇，450 为根。/ The four single-event stories 475, 480, 485 and 490 are merged here under root 450.
- 不确定 Uncertain：各结局的好感修正数值在 opinion_modifiers 中，未逐项核对。/ Opinion modifier values not checked.
- 2026-10-13 r3-inherit：事件继承修复（base = 其他事件）后复查：对照游戏文件核对了现在可见的继承标题、选项与分支，结构无需改动。
  2026-10-13 r3-inherit: re-checked after the event-inheritance fix (base = other event): the inherited titles, options and branches now visible in the tree were compared with the game files; no structural change needed.
